limitations: Research shortlist only: no founding points, population proposals, corrected bank positions or import JSON. Generic city coordinates may be outside the historic core. Regional context sources support examples, not every named town. Detailed per-site pre-1800 verification remains required. Distance to a town is Euclidean across water and mountains, not travel distance, rural population coverage or proof that another town is needed.
